description: The line plot illustrates the trade-off between cost and reliability score for three different SQL generation approaches: a 3-Model Ensemble (blue), a 2-Model Ensemble (red), and GPT-4 (yellow), as evaluated in the PromptMind Team’s EHRSQL-2024 study. The x-axis, labeled “Cost,” ranges from 0 to 10 with tick marks at intervals of 2, representing a linear scale of computational or financial cost. The y-axis, labeled “Reliability Score,” spans from 30 to 90 with tick marks at intervals of 20, indicating a linear scale of performance reliability. The blue line (3-Model Ensemble) begins at approximately 85 at cost 0, gently declines to about 78 at cost 5, and ends near 73 at cost 10. The red line (2-Model Ensemble) starts slightly higher at ~87, decreases to ~77 at cost 5, and ends at ~72 at cost 10. The yellow line (GPT-4) starts at ~89, drops sharply to ~66 at cost 5, and continues declining to ~42 at cost 10, showing the steepest degradation in reliability with increasing cost. All lines are solid with circular markers at data points, and the legend in the top-left corner identifies each method by color and label.
